The Clan Hearth is your invitation to explore Scotland with the warmth of kin. Dive into living clan histories, trace ancestral footsteps with immersive maps, and craft journeys alongside Highland guides who keep the flame alight.

  • Clan Dossiers: Tartans, lineages, and legends restored from museum archives and family keepers.
  • Immersive Maps: Layer historic territories over Highlands, Isles, and Lowlands routes.
  • Och-I Companion: Gaelic phrases, recipes, and rituals tailored to every gathering.
  • Member Exclusives: Collect heirloom keepsakes, session replays, and seasonal ceremonies.

Inside the Hearth Daily Spark

  • Plot historic clan territories alongside modern journeys with synchronized map layers.
  • Experience the Thread of Ages timeline—animated eras with music, artefacts, and storycards.
  • Share recipes, rituals, and seasonal celebrations that keep your hearth blazing year-round.
